source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
completion:
Find the 2019 AP42 Emission Factors.
- [Link to the US-EPA AP42 database of Emission Factors](https://www.epa.gov/air-emissions-factors-and-quantification/ap-42-compilation-air-emissions-factors) 3. Calculate the hours for which a specific machine ran. 4. Convert the number of hours run to cubic feet of fuel consumed.
- Use a conversion factor of 12,000 to 18,000 btu/gal for NG, and 130,000 to 140,000 btu/gal for diesel 5. Use the fuel-consumption figure to calculate the emissions (lbs/hr) of criteria pollutants (CO, SO2, NOx, PM10/2.5).
